_doc: Test families for CI selection (build/ci-select.mjs). script = the package.json script; globs = what it runs; needsBuild = loads the dev build (dist/band-coach.html via tests/helpers/html-path.mjs); needsRelease = drives dist/release. Every family script builds what its flags declare before its tests (tests/unit/test-scripts-build-what-they-need.test.mjs enforces it); a dev build deletes dist/, so it runs before the release build. browser = families whose files launch Chromium. rules: the FIRST rule matching a changed file decides which families that file selects; a file no rule matches selects everything (test:all), as does an empty list. Selecting every family prints test:all.

browserFiles: about a dozen files under tests/unit launch Chromium: see tests/helpers/browser.mjs imports
